title: Dropped Virtual Care Sessions: Reconnection, Phone Completion and No-Charge Closure
content:
When a Virtual Care session drops, the clinician tries to reconnect the visit type's number of reconnection attempts and, where the visit type allows phone fallback, completes the encounter by phone as the same encounter.

## Standard

1. **Reconnection and phone completion.** When a session drops, the clinician tries to reconnect the visit type's number of reconnection attempts and, where the visit type's phone fallback setting is Yes, completes the encounter by phone as the same encounter. That encounter closes with the end reason audio fallback completed and is charged normally.
2. **No-charge closure.** When the encounter cannot be completed and the connected time is below the visit type's technical-failure threshold, it closes with the end reason technical failure, no charge: no charge is billed, any prepayment is refunded, and a new encounter is offered at no charge.
3. **Charged closure.** When the encounter cannot be completed and the connected time is at or above the threshold, it is charged as completed.
4. **Either side.** A failure on the patient's side is treated the same way as one on the group's side.

## Input, judgement, outcome

| Completed by phone as the same encounter? | Connected time against the threshold | Where the failure arose | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Any | Patient's side or group's side | Audio fallback completed; charged normally |
| No | Below the threshold | Patient's side or group's side | Technical failure, no charge: nothing billed, any prepayment refunded, new encounter offered at no charge |
| No | At or above the threshold | Patient's side or group's side | Charged as completed |

## Worked cases (hypothetical threshold of 10 minutes)

- A video session drops after 6 connected minutes; reconnection fails and the encounter is not completed by phone. 6 minutes is below 10, so the encounter closes as technical failure, no charge; any prepayment held is refunded and a new encounter is offered at no charge.
- The same drop after 12 connected minutes, not completed: 12 minutes is at or above 10, so the encounter is charged as completed.
- A drop after 10 connected minutes, not completed: 10 minutes is not below 10, so the encounter is charged as completed.
- A drop after 3 connected minutes, after which the clinician completes the encounter by phone as the same encounter: it closes as audio fallback completed and is charged normally.
- The patient's own internet connection fails after 4 connected minutes and the encounter is not completed: the failure is treated the same as one on the group's side, so the encounter closes as technical failure, no charge.
